LESSON: PRINT AWARENESS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.1: Print awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Print awareness, part of Writing in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: How can we make pictures?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify pictures of familiar things within the environment,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Print awareness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. scribble freely on books in preparation for writing,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Print awareness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. enjoy scribbling on books and other surfaces in preparation for writing ● Recognize pictures of familiar things within their environment (on charts, books, digital devices), ● Talk about the pictures. SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Print awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Responsibility is developed as the learner scribbles on books and colour pictures without assistance.

• Peace is enhanced as the learner shares scribbling and colouring materials such as pencils and crayons without scrambling.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Hygiene under health related issues is enhanced as the learner washes hands with soap and clean water after a modelling learning

experience.

Link to other Learning Areas: environmental activities as the learner recognises pictures of familiar things within their

environment.

Suggested learning resources: Charts with pictures of familiar things in their environment, books, digital devices, pencils
